bounded_oracle_proofs.scope: Finite nonnegative original A710 upload rectangles with y+height <= 480, using unchanged HERCULES.EXE A710 and BD80 instructions in Unicorn. This is not FUNCTION_MATCH, full A710-domain, image-storage extent, renderer, gameplay, or module acceptance.
limitations: Only finite synthetic inputs were executed; the complete valid callback domain and ownership extent are unproved.
Only the known y<512 producer band was used; y>=512/index-derived writes were deliberately excluded.
No CRT memcpy call exists in the measured A710 span; native string instructions and byte stores perform the upload.
No GPU, DirectDraw, rasterization, packet dispatch, gameplay, source identity, FUNCTION_MATCH, or whole-module result is claimed.

bounded_oracle_proofs.scope: Finite one-row, two-pixel C700/C882 execution from original RVA C7F6 through the C89F inner-loop boundary. Source bytes 0 and 7; zero bypasses all destination/LUT access, nonzero uses frame_color_lut[0x23*256+7], then blend[(mapped_color<<8)|old_destination]. This is not full rasterization, renderer integration, gameplay, FUNCTION_MATCH, or whole-module equality.
limitations: Only finite two-pixel rows were executed; clipping and complete raster paths were not exercised.
This covers the C700 color-LUT plus blend path only; D420/CC50 palette CLUT and other copy/blend helpers remain separate.
No GPU, DirectDraw, gameplay, source identity, FUNCTION_MATCH, or whole-module result is claimed.

static_proofs.scope: Static E1, command-01 and F3 state-command fields. No packet decoder, rasterizer, gameplay execution, or source-identity claim.
